title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
description: A carnival showman, a sleepwalker and a string of murders arrive through one of the strangest landscapes ever put on film. German Expressionism makes the entire movie look like the walls have started lying.
rightsLabel: Internet Archive item marked Public Domain
contentNote: Silent horror with murder, psychological distress and unsettling imagery.

title: The Phantom of the Opera
description: Lon Chaney hides beneath the Paris Opera House, causing trouble, making demands and demonstrating why secret underground apartments are rarely a healthy lifestyle choice.
rightsLabel: Internet Archive item marked Public Domain
contentNote: Silent horror with threatening behavior and frightening imagery.

title: Häxan
description: Part documentary, part nightmare and part extremely questionable historical lecture, Häxan examines witchcraft, superstition and mass hysteria through images that remain genuinely bizarre.
rightsLabel: Internet Archive item marked Public Domain
contentNote: Mature historical imagery involving witchcraft, torture, nudity and religious themes.

title: Night of the Living Dead
description: A small group of survivors boards up a farmhouse while an inexplicable outbreak spreads outside. Scrappy, intense and still unsettling decades later.
rightsLabel: Internet Archive item marked Public Domain
contentNote: Black-and-white horror with violence, threat, and disturbing scenes.
